subject: AvaCloud vendor setup — spend cap confirmation & line-item adjustments
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@avacloud.io>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@avacloud.io
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — initial spend caps and PO requirement

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this on. We're completing the Redwood vendor onboarding checklist and need a confirmed PO number for May billing. A few quick items: 
- Target monthly spend cap: $75,000 (expected ramp: 30k May / 65k June / steady-state 75k)
- Line items: please confirm the usage SKU code we should expect — our export shows "INF-L" but procurement requested the contract reference to be "INF-L1" so our AP system will match invoices.
- Onboarding form attached (W-9 + vendor information).

Can you confirm a PO number and whether Redwood needs any additional vendor docs? If there's a procurement form you prefer, send it and we'll fill it out.

Thanks,
Liam O'Neill
Head of Procurement, AvaCloud
liam.oneill@avacloud.io

Attachments: vendor_W9.pdf (W-9, vendor contact sheet)

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@avacloud.io>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:28:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — initial spend caps and PO requirement

Dylan / Evelyn — looping you in to issue a PO and confirm spend caps for AvaCloud.

Summary from vendor: monthly cap target $75k; they called out a mismatch on the SKU (INF-L vs INF-L1) which will block matching on their side. Can finance: 
- Issue a PO for May with a monthly cap of $75,000 and PO number clearly visible on the header (we prefer PO in the format PO-xxxxx-RI)
- Set automated alert thresholds at 70% and 90% of the monthly cap so we can notify the vendor before cutover
- Correct the line item SKU to INF-L1 and confirm unit price ($0.012/token) — vendor states current system export uses INF-L which causes rejections.

Liam — attaching the vendor W-9 you provided (see original). If finance needs a Redwood vendor onboarding form, Evelyn has the template.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 11:05:22 -0700
Subject: PO issued: PO-78921-RI — AvaCloud onboarding (spend cap & SKU correction)

Liam / Karthik,

Thanks for the details — I've issued PO-78921-RI and attached the PDF to this thread (PO-78921.pdf). Key points captured: 
- Monthly spend cap set to $75,000. Alerts configured at 70% ($52,500) and 90% ($67,500). Finance will send over notifications to both the vendor and the account lead when thresholds are hit.
- Line item SKU updated to INF-L1 (was INF-L). Unit price set to $0.012/token per the quote. If you need alternative unit denominations, let me know.
- Vendor onboarding form: we've filled and attached the Redwood onboarding form (vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf). Please review the billing address — I used the address Liam provided but flagged it for confirmation.

DocuSign link for the PO and standard vendor terms: https://redwood.app/docusign/PO-78921 (expires in 7 days).

Attachments: PO-78921.pdf (official PO), vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf

Next steps: 
- Liam: confirm billing address and sign the DocuSign envelope.
- Karthik: confirm that the SKU and unit price match commercial terms so we can finalize invoicing.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
